claims.claim: Large-scale randomized studies show that high-impact tutoring lifts achievement by 0.41 standard deviations on average.
spaced practice typically improves long-term retention by 10 to 30 percent compared with massed practice in classroom studies.
One 2024 randomized trial found that structured tutoring reduced course dropout by 18 percent.
Retrieval practice strengthens memory more than rereading in most classroom experiments.
